budget_decision: Five-epoch paired train/val pilot showed ongoing but diminishing first-reference CE improvement through epoch 5 in both arms. Twenty epochs cover every train reference at least once; ten further balanced visits provide a half-cycle beyond that floor. Freeze 30 epochs for all six arms before test access, irrespective of sign of later validation differences.
reference_policy: one deterministic balanced reference per train video per epoch; all references covered by epoch 20
endpoint_selection: fixed epoch 30 for every arm and seed; never choose checkpoint or decode from test
paired_retrieval_direction_rule: On val497, require B caption gate for all three seeds, positive mean B-A T2V R@1, and at least two positive paired seeds; a failure is retained as a valid negative result.
test_policy: After six-arm validation_freeze.json only, run one fixed test2990 evaluation with every seed/arm endpoint; test never selects the model or protocol.
